headline: Global market conditions (260703) - Dow hits record high as AI, chips slide
deck: Sentiment toward AI and semiconductors weakened again as chip indices and major tech names fell sharply, while capital rotated into blue chips, consumer staples, healthcare, and utilities and the Dow reached a record high.

key_points: Weakening AI and semiconductor sentiment pushed the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 5%.
Capital rotated into blue chips, consumer staples, healthcare, and utilities as the Dow hit a record high.
A clear rotation from growth into defensive and quality names emerged across the session.
risk_note: Whether volatility in AI and semiconductor names persists, and whether the defensive rotation continues, remain key near-term variables to watch.
